notes:
BUILD 60
- The island is about twice the size (3072 m across, was 2048 m). OLD SAVES DO NOT LOAD on the new island: start a new game. Loading takes longer than before.
- Two new settings for speed, under OPTIONS: RENDER SCALE draws the world at a lower resolution and stretches it to the window (the menus and HUD stay sharp), and SHADOWS can be switched off. On a screen bigger than 1080p the render scale starts at 75%.
- Weapons work inside the Outpost. Shooting is fine; hitting a scientist, a trader, a turret or anything of theirs that breaks (barrels, crates, pumps) is what locks the turrets on to you.
